text:
alex chen: FYI opened a docs PR to refresh the Optimize Toolkit Go snippet (KV prefetch + batching + quant profiles). Old sample used deprecated SDK calls and the external gist link is dead. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/447

maria ramos: thanks @alex. i can rewrite the Go example. question: do we show ContinuousBatcher (recommended) or keep Batcher for backwards compatibility?

alex chen: show ContinuousBatcher as primary, but add a one-line note with the legacy Batcher equivalence. also recommend the shortseq quant profile for chat summary workloads.

samir patel: CI note: replace external gist with internal example path so docs-checks can embed snippets: /examples/optimize/kv_prefetch/go/main.go

katie-ux: could we include a tiny before/after perf mini-table? two rows: legacy vs prefetch+continuous. helps convey impact quickly.

maria ramos: good call. i'll add a 2-row table and a runnable microbench command: `go run ./examples/optimize/kv_prefetch/go --profile shortseq --batch continuous`

maria ramos: proposed Go snippet:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
cb := optimize.NewContinuousBatcher(client, optimize.WithKVPrefetch())
resp, err := cb.Generate(ctx, "Summarize: ...", optimize.WithQuantProfile("shortseq"))
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```

alex chen: looks clear. add a short fallback note: "If KV prefetch misses, the request falls back to the single-request path; expect ~1.8x latency."
samir patel: i left a PR comment to add a unit test pointer and to use the internal snippet path for CI extraction.

katie-ux: wording nit: change header from "KV-prefetch" to "KV prefetch (optional)" so it's not read as mandatory.

maria ramos: pushed update with header tweak, internal path fix, and the perf table. added a 1-paragraph note about pinning quant profiles in Dedicated deployments + crosslink to /dedicated/configuring-quant-profiles.

alex chen: LGTM. approving now. thanks everyone :tada:
samir patel: merging once final CI finishes.
